posts.zh:
dsh-boot-guard 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

posts.en:
dsh-boot-guard is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Loader-independent startup recovery for DSH Web that detects likely broken plugins, temporarily skips them, and restores only Boot Guard-managed changes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-98ac95fd116367b381df.html
